stories.label: US tells Afghan allies to give up — 173-year resettlement backlog
stories.summary: DHS admits 173-year processing backlog. 180,000 Afghans in pipeline. Camp As-Sayliyah closing March 31. Advocates told 1,000 Afghans on Zoom to give up on America.

stories.label: Iran crisis — China missile deal ahead of Feb 26 Geneva talks
stories.summary: Feb 26 Geneva talks Thursday. China missile deal confirmed. White House says diplomacy is first option. Iran students protesting for third day. Importance decayed since not selected this cycle.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — 4th anniversary, execution testimony
stories.summary: BBC obtained firsthand testimony from Russian soldiers describing execution of troops who refuse orders. Mediazona verified 200K+ Russian dead. War entering 5th year with no diplomatic breakthrough.

stories.label: Lebanon army ordered to respond after Israeli fire on military post
stories.summary: Lebanese Army told to act in self-defense after Israeli forces fired on a military post. Shifts dynamic from Israel vs. Hezbollah to Israel vs. sovereign military. Could widen conflict.

stories.label: Thai and Cambodian armies exchange fire at disputed border
stories.summary: Thai and Cambodian militaries exchanged live fire at their border. First significant shooting since the 2008-2011 Preah Vihear dispute era. ASEAN response pending.

stories.label: Stripe reportedly in talks to acquire PayPal
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Stripe exploring PayPal acquisition. Would be one of largest fintech deals ever. Stripe has growing stablecoin/blockchain ambitions.

stories.label: China-Japan export war / US chip control regime under pressure
stories.summary: Two-front story: China sanctioned 40 Japanese entities and DeepSeek circumvented Nvidia Blackwell ban. Export control regime being simultaneously retaliated against and evaded.

stories.label: M23 spokesperson killed in drone strike — Congo mineral war
stories.summary: M23 military spokesperson Lt. Col Willy Ngoma killed by drone in eastern DRC. M23 controls Rubaya coltan mine supplying 15% of world's tantalum. 7M+ displaced.

stories.label: Chinese scientists build world's smallest transistor for AI chips
stories.summary: World's smallest, most efficient ferroelectric transistor. Integrates memory and processing in single unit. Alternative architecture path may circumvent Western export controls.

stories.label: Russia opens criminal case against Telegram founder Durov
stories.summary: Both France and Russia now pursuing criminal cases against Durov. Democratic and authoritarian states targeting same encrypted platform for opposite reasons. 900M+ users affected.

stories.label: Moscow bomb kills police officer on Ukraine war anniversary
stories.summary: Bomb detonated in Moscow killed police officer on 4th anniversary of Ukraine invasion. Separate from rail hub suicide bombing same day. Internal security under strain.

stories.label: Sahel jihadist groups probing coastal West Africa
stories.summary: Jihadist groups expanding from Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger into Senegal's east. Watch for Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Togo — coastal belt is the next front.

stories.label: ICC prosecution: Duterte drew up 'death lists' for drug war
stories.summary: ICC prosecutors revealed Duterte personally drew up 'death lists' and boasted about killings. First SE Asian head of state at ICC. Drug war killed 12,000-30,000. Hearing ongoing.

stories.label: Netanyahu announces Israel-India 'hexagon' alliance against 'radical axes'
stories.summary: Netanyahu framed 6-nation alliance (Israel, India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Greece, Cyprus) against 'radical axes.' Israeli opposition boycotting Modi's Knesset address. Formalizes anti-Iran coalition with Hindu-nationalist India.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Section 122 tariffs in effect
stories.summary: Section 122 tariffs took effect at lower-than-expected rate. Dollar under pressure. China weighing response. Importance decayed — no major new development this cycle.

stories.label: USFK chief apologizes to South Korea after China air standoff
stories.summary: USFK commander apologized after Feb 20 Yellow Sea air standoff with China. Alliance strain visible.

stories.label: Settlers kill Palestinian teen while Israeli soldiers watched
stories.summary: Settlers attacked Mukhmas, shot three, killed teenager. Soldiers stood by. Military complicity pattern accelerating.

stories.label: Nigeria central bank cuts rate to 26.5% amid economic crisis
stories.summary: Nigeria's central bank cut benchmark rate to 26.5% — crisis-level by global standards but an easing in Nigeria. Inflation above 30%, naira collapsed, 133M in poverty.

stories.label: Discovery rewrites humanity's first exodus from Africa
stories.summary: Archaeological discovery in Israel upends established timeline of humanity's first migration out of Africa through the Levant corridor.

stories.label: Hidden human labor behind 'autonomous' humanoid robots exposed
stories.summary: MIT Tech Review reveals humanoid robot companies hiding human operators. Pattern mirrors safety drivers and AI content editors.

stories.label: Iron Age mass grave reveals targeted violence against women and children
stories.summary: Nature study documents unprecedented evidence of targeted violence against women and children in Iron Age.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — 10,000 troops deployed after El Mencho death
stories.summary: 70+ killed. 10,000 troops deployed. 23 inmates sprung from jail during violence. Subsiding but cartel fragmentation risk remains.

stories.label: Israel designates and shuts down Palestinian news outlets
stories.summary: 5 Palestinian news orgs designated terrorist groups. Physical shutdowns now being enforced in Jerusalem. Criminalizes consuming or working for outlets.

stories.label: US withdraws from NE Syria, abandoning Kurdish allies
stories.summary: US pulling out of NE Syria. Full withdrawal within a month. Turkey repatriating ISIS fighters.

stories.label: Panama takes control of canal ports from Hong Kong firm
stories.summary: Supreme Court declared CK Hutchison concession unconstitutional. Hong Kong lodged 'strong protest' after takeover.

stories.label: Binance fired employees who found $1.7B sent to Iran
stories.summary: NYT reports compliance employees discovered $1.7B in crypto routed to Iran and were fired.

stories.label: IBM posts worst day in 25 years after AI threatens COBOL moat
stories.summary: IBM steepest stock drop since 2000 after Anthropic showed AI can modernize COBOL.

stories.label: Deadly floods sweep Peru — 700+ districts in emergency
stories.summary: 700+ districts declared emergency. Torrential rains trigger mudslides. La Niña-driven climate event.

stories.label: App detects smart glasses wearers nearby — counter-surveillance tool
stories.summary: New app detects Meta Ray-Bans and similar smart glasses via Bluetooth scanning. Inverts surveillance dynamic — users warned when being recorded.

stories.label: Brazil reverses Amazon port expansion after Indigenous protests
stories.summary: Government revoked Amazon port expansion. Soy industry abandoned deforestation moratorium — pressure continues.

stories.label: Kim Yo-jong promoted at rare North Korea party congress
stories.summary: Kim Yo-jong promoted to full department director. Formalizes extensive informal power. Succession signal.

stories.label: Sudan war — humanitarian crisis deepening
stories.summary: Chad border still closed. Quad ceasefire proposal on table. Needs dedicated internal humanitarian angle when fresh data emerges.

stories.label: France restricts US Ambassador Kushner after he ignores summons
stories.summary: France stripped Ambassador Kushner of direct ministerial access. NATO ally downgrading US ambassador.

stories.label: Israel advances death penalty bill targeting Palestinians
stories.summary: Knesset debating death penalty bill. First execution since Eichmann (1962) would be Palestinian.

stories.label: African gig workers unknowingly trained US military AI
stories.summary: Rest of World investigation. Data labelers in Africa unknowingly worked on US military contracts.

stories.label: AI tools can now design entire genomes from scratch
stories.summary: AI systems architecting whole organisms. Biosecurity governance gap widening.

stories.label: ASML EUV breakthrough could yield 50% more chips by 2030
stories.summary: ASML unveils new EUV light source technology. 50% more chips from same equipment by 2030.
